scope.population: 2,480,267 rows of the trade-print panel; every fill with a finite markout and a finite start_pos enters, with no per-wallet fill floor, no resampling and no randomness
scope.window: 10 days present in the input, day-of-month 4-13; the calendar dates of the window are declared by its producer, build_quickwin_markouts.py

declared_not_confirmed.note: settings.py declares these; this run did not state what it used, so they are the declaration and not a property of this artifact

_meta.object: M6 - toxicity vs signed pre-trade inventory
_meta.markout_sign: signed taker markout bps; positive = taker profited = maker adverse-selected
_meta.magnitude_test: Spearman rho of the 60s and 10s taker markout vs |start_pos|, each under its own key
_meta.direction_test: mean markout, accumulating (extend) vs reducing (cut), where extend = sign(start_pos) * [+1 buy-aggr / -1 sell-aggr] > 0
_meta.start_pos_coverage: 100% present; ~87.8% nonzero; start_pos==0 kept in the |start_pos| Spearman, excluded from the directional split

magnitude.note: positive rho => bigger pre-trade inventory associates with more taker markout (more maker adverse selection)

accumulating.definition: taker trades SAME direction as existing inventory

reducing.definition: taker trades OPPOSITE direction to existing inventory

direction.note: positive gap => fills that BUILD inventory carry higher taker markout than fills that CUT it; start_pos==0 rows excluded
